needs_key.about: What each pet needs to work, in its own entry as `needs` (Astra, 2026-10-20: one place, pets.json, checked by npm test). A pet pack (scripts/pet-packs-20261020.mjs) reads it to say plainly what works alone and what needs a farm; later the Friendly Farmer reads it to add one pet to a farm (farm.lock). Four kinds, each a list: `os` (the computer its own program runs on; its pet program page and Markdown pet open in any browser anyway), `pets` (other pets, by repo), `core` (parts of the core that only a farm has) and `programs` (third-party programs, by their node id in system-map.json). Each item of pets, core and programs says `how` and `why`. Only what works today or is planned: ideas nobody agreed to are not needs.

how.required: Its own program does not do its job without it.
how.optional: It works without it; one of its tools, a planned connection or its desktop pet needs it.
